en: Black‑and‑white view of a walled entrance gate in a pine forest, leading along a straight road to a large multi‑storey institutional building with a steep tiled roof and dormers. The gatehouse has a hipped tile roof, arched wooden door with metal bars and small signs, and is attached to a plastered wall with vertical fence slats. Tall, thin conifer trees dominate both sides of the road. The architecture suggests an early‑20th‑century Central European sanatorium, hospital, or similar facility.
